description: You are a project architect at a small residential design firm. The garage floor plan at '/home/ga/Documents/LibreCAD/floorplan.dxf' needs to be submitted for a building permit. The permit office requires a formal drawing sheet with a complete title block. Your task is to prepare this drawing for permit submission by adding a professional title block that meets standard architectural drawing requirements. The title block must include: (1) a project title and address, (2) a drawing number and sheet designation, (3) a revision history section showing at least one revision entry, (4) a designated space for the architect's seal with appropriate text, and (5) the drawing scale. The title block elements must be organized on appropriate dedicated layers, and the title block border must be clearly delineated with line entities forming a structured grid or frame. Save the completed drawing to '/home/ga/Documents/LibreCAD/floorplan_sheet.dxf'.
